criteria.park_ceiling: designer_stage.open_run: a concept whose judge-and-rework loop has spent more than twice its cap since the last park lift is parked; nothing opens until his own word (ownerSaid or byCard on an OWNER event) names the concept's item (standing_park)
criteria.stale_root_reopens_stage_1: designer_stage.reopen_if_stale: the earliest accepted stage whose inputs changed is reopened before any later stage runs (stage 1 depends on root)
criteria.judge_needs_stage5_exam: coverage_judge.run: judges only at stage 5 with exam.json passing (or exam_waived in his words)

refusals.observed: A preview of open_run (commit=False, on a scratch copy after unblock) refused: 'PARKED (ceiling): the judge-and-rework loop has spent 8070268 tokens since 2026-11-06T02:30:55Z, past its ceiling of 8000000 (2x the cap); nothing opens until his word on BAROQUE_SCRIPT_MEASURE_PREP_AND_CONTROLS'. His card of 2026-11-14 (one exam and one judge pass, no loop) is recorded on RIMMANDRAKE_ADVANCE_PYRELANDS_OFFLINE_BESIDE_THE_PILOT, not on the concept's stage item, so standing_park does not see it. (His card: OWNER event tsn 1794721014843506307.)
refusals.would_pass: An OWNER event with byCard or ownerSaid naming BAROQUE_SCRIPT_MEASURE_PREP_AND_CONTROLS, written after the park; or standing_park reading his word on the mod's ADVANCE item too.

smallest_fix.what: Record his 2026-11-14 card (one exam and one judge pass on the locked tree, no loop) as a --by-card OWNER event on item BAROQUE_SCRIPT_MEASURE_PREP_AND_CONTROLS, then `designer_stage.py unblock design/concepts/Pyrelands --why ...` (or `coverage_judge.py release`).

refusals.criterion_why: The ceiling exists to stop unattended rework loops; it rightly wants his word, it only reads it on a different item id than the one his card was filed on.

refusals.observed: Stage 1 was accepted 2026-11-06 with root hash 219a7768...; record.json's root now hashes ae26d34f..., changed by his card 2026-11-14 'Drop the sentence' (commit f71693d77a, which also changed tree, sheet and scenes). stale_stage = (1, ['root']); stages 2 and 3 are stale too (root, owner, sheet, tree, scenes). Once the hold and the park lift, open_run reopens stage 1 (Argue the idea), discards the accepted results for stages 1-3, and the chain (chain_stages, up to 8 a day) runs stages 1, 2, 3 before any exam. Those are Designer rework runs on a locked tree, which this brief forbids ('no loop'; 'never edit a bar, the sheet or the plan').
refusals.would_pass: The accepted stage 1-3 results carry the current inputs because the change is his own locked_change on the locked version, so stage 4 (Exam) is the open stage.

smallest_fix.what: Add a designer_stage verb that re-pins the accepted results' inputs to the current hashes when the change is an owner-only record kind (locked_change) citing an OWNER event (here his 2026-11-14 card, commit f71693d77a), refusing otherwise; then open runs stage 4. The alternative, letting stages 1-3 rerun as confirm-as-is Designer runs, costs about three runs (~$8 cap each) and may edit the locked tree.

refusals.criterion_why: Sound for an unlocked concept; for a version locked by his word, a change he made by card is not new design input to re-argue, and the stage machine has no way to tell the two apart.

refusals.observed: The coverage judge runs only at stage 5 with a passing exam; the concept is at stage 4 with an exam.json that no longer matches the tree and sheet, and the ceiling stops judging too. No judge was launched. `coverage_judge.py status` at 2026-11-14 9:40 PM PST printed the ceiling line.
refusals.would_pass: The exam passes on the locked tree (after the two fixes above), then `coverage_judge.py run design/concepts/Pyrelands` at stage 5.

smallest_fix.what: None of its own: it follows from the two refusals above.

refusals.criterion_why: A coverage verdict on a tree the exam has not read would be signed against an unexamined tree.
